responsibility: Implements GCC’s modref analysis and propagation passes for function memory behavior. It builds local and LTO-streamable summaries of loads, stores, kills, escape/EAF flags, and per-edge fnspec/escape information; propagates summaries through SCCs of the callgraph; updates summaries after inlining and signature changes; and leaves optimization summaries for alias analysis, FRE/PRE/GVN, DSE, and other clients that decide whether loads and stores can be reused or removed. This is an upstream analysis source for memory-dependence facts, whereas tree-ssa aliasing and value-numbering files are downstream consumers of those facts.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual modref analysis and propagation passes over functions and the callgraph, including fnspec and escape summaries, SCC propagation, summary updates after inlining, and finalization. Unlike gcc/ipa-modref.h, it is the analysis engine; unlike ipa-modref-tree.*, it uses the access-tree container rather than defining it. If a bug appears in FRE, PRE, GVN, or alias-driven optimization after IPA summaries are available, this file is the source of interprocedural mod/ref facts rather than the local optimization driver.
